```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
viewof newData = Inputs.button("New data")
round = newData

mutable submitted = false
mutable submittedGuess = null
mutable submittedRound = null

{
  newData;
  mutable submitted = false;
}

game = {
  newData;

  const rho = +(Math.random() * 2 - 1).toFixed(2);

  const normal = d3.randomNormal(0, 1);

  const points = d3.range(40).map(() => {
    const x = normal();
    const z = normal();
    const y = rho * x + Math.sqrt(1 - rho * rho) * z;
    return {x, y};
  });

  return {rho, points};
}

```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function rescale(values, min = -2.5, max = 2.5) {
  const lo = d3.min(values);
  const hi = d3.max(values);

  return values.map(v =>
    (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (max - min) + min
  );
}

scaled = {
  const xs = rescale(game.points.map(d => d.x));
  const ys = rescale(game.points.map(d => d.y));

  return xs.map((x, i) => ({
    x,
    y: ys[i]
  }));
}

```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
xbar = d3.mean(scaled, d => d.x)

ybar = d3.mean(scaled, d => d.y)

slope =
  d3.sum(scaled, d => (d.x - xbar) * (d.y - ybar)) /
  d3.sum(scaled, d => (d.x - xbar) ** 2)

intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

preds = [
  {x: -2.6, y: intercept + slope * -2.6},
  {x:  2.6, y: intercept + slope *  2.6}
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
correlation = {
  const mx = d3.mean(scaled, d => d.x);
  const my = d3.mean(scaled, d => d.y);

  const cov = d3.mean(scaled, d => (d.x - mx) * (d.y - my));

  const sx = Math.sqrt(d3.mean(scaled, d => (d.x - mx) ** 2));
  const sy = Math.sqrt(d3.mean(scaled, d => (d.y - my) ** 2));

  return cov / (sx * sy);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof submit = Inputs.button("Submit", {
  reduce: () => {
    mutable submitted = true;
    mutable submittedGuess = n;
    mutable submittedRound = round;

    return Date.now();
  }
})

roundFinished = submittedRound === round

feedbackVisible = {
  if (!roundFinished) return false;

  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 900));
  return true;
}

feedback = {
  if (!feedbackVisible)
    return html`
      <div class="feedback"></div>
    `;

  const err = Math.abs(submittedGuess - correlation);
  const r = correlation.toFixed(2);
  const roundedCorrelation = +correlation.toFixed(2);

  if (submittedGuess === roundedCorrelation)
  return html`
    <div class="feedback perfect show">
      <strong>Perfect!</strong><br>
      You guessed the correlation exactly.
    </div>
  `;

if (err < 0.05)
  return html`
    <div class="feedback excellent show">
      <strong>Excellent!</strong><br>
      You were off by <strong>${err.toFixed(2)}</strong>. The correlation was <strong>${r}</strong>.
    </div>
  `;

  if (err < 0.15)
    return html`
      <div class="feedback close show">
        <strong>Very close!</strong><br>
        You were off by <strong>${err.toFixed(2)}</strong>. The correlation was <strong>${r}</strong>.
      </div>
    `;

  if (err < 0.30)
    return html`
      <div class="feedback ok show">
        <strong>Not bad.</strong><br>
        The correlation was <strong>${r}</strong>.
      </div>
    `;

  return html`
    <div class="feedback practice show">
      <strong>Keep practicing.</strong><br>
      The correlation was <strong>${r}</strong>.
    </div>
  `;
}
```

```{ojs D3 plot1}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
d3 = require("d3@7")

yAccessor = d => d.y
xAccessor = d => d.x

width = 750 * (6.5 / 11)

dimensions = ({ 
    width: width, 
    height: width * 0.75,
    margin: {
      top: 23,
      right: 25,
      bottom: 45,
      left: 75,
   },
})

dimensions.boundedWidth = dimensions.width
    - dimensions.margin.left
    - dimensions.margin.right
  dimensions.boundedHeight = dimensions.height
    - dimensions.margin.top
    - dimensions.margin.bottom
    
wrapper = d3.select(DOM.svg(dimensions.width, dimensions.height))
        .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, dimensions.width, dimensions.height]);
    
bounds = wrapper
    .append("g") 
    .style("transform", `translate(${
        dimensions.margin.left
    }px, ${ 
     dimensions.margin.top
    }px)`)
    
xScale = d3.scaleLinear() 
    .domain([-3, 3])
    .range([0, dimensions.boundedWidth])
    
    
yScale = d3.scaleLinear() 
    .domain([-3, 3])
    .range([dimensions.boundedHeight, 0]) 
    
xAxisGenerator = d3.axisBottom() 
    .scale(xScale)
    .ticks(8);

yAxisGenerator = d3.axisLeft() 
    .scale(yScale)
    .ticks(8);

xTicks = [-2.2, -0.733333, 0.733333, 2.2];
yTicks = [-2.2, -0.733333, 0.733333, 2.2];

bounds.append("g")
  .attr("class", "grid")
  .call(
    d3.axisLeft(yScale)
      .tickValues(yTicks)
      .tickSize(-dimensions.boundedWidth)
      .tickFormat("")
  );

bounds.append("g")
  .attr("class", "grid")
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${dimensions.boundedHeight})`)
  .call(
    d3.axisBottom(xScale)
      .tickValues(xTicks)
      .tickSize(-dimensions.boundedHeight)
      .tickFormat("")
  );
    
<!-- yAxis = bounds.append("g")  -->
<!--     .call(yAxisGenerator) -->
<!--     .style("transform", `translateX(${- 10}px)`) -->
<!--     .style("color", "#888") -->

<!-- xAxis = bounds.append("g") -->
<!--     .call(xAxisGenerator) -->
<!--     .style("transform", `translateY(${dimensions.boundedHeight + 10}px)`) -->
<!--     .style("color", "#888") -->
    
lineg = d3.line()
  .x(d => xScale(d.x))
  .y(d => yScale(d.y))
 
plot_game =  {
  const dots = bounds
    .selectAll(".dots")
    .data(scaled)
    
  dots
    .join("circle")
    .classed("dots", true)
    .transition()
    .duration(750)
    .ease(d3.easeQuadOut)
    .delay(0)
    .attr("fill", "#1982c4")
    .attr("opacity", 0.65)
    .attr("r", 6)
    .attr("cx", d => xScale(xAccessor(d)))
    .attr("cy", d => yScale(yAccessor(d)))

  
  const ll = bounds
  .selectAll(".ll")
  .data(roundFinished ? [preds] : []);

ll.join(
  enter => {
    const path = enter
      .append("path")
      .classed("ll", true)
      .attr("d", d => lineg(d))
      .attr("stroke", "#4b5563")
      .attr("stroke-width", 3)
      .attr("fill", "none");

    path.each(function() {
      const length = this.getTotalLength();

      d3.select(this)
        .attr("stroke-dasharray", `${length} ${length}`)
        .attr("stroke-dashoffset", length)
        .transition()
        .duration(750)
        .ease(d3.easeQuadOut)
        .attr("stroke-dashoffset", 0);
    });

    return path;
  },
  update => update,
  exit => exit.remove()
);
    
  return wrapper.node()
}
```
